# Artifact Gateway v0.3.1

## 简体中文

本版本让已授权的同事在控制台查看仓库和制品，并按角色使用发布功能。`reader` 可以查看有读取权限的仓库；`writer` 还可以使用 Raw 文件上传、Maven 发布向导和 OCI/npm/PyPI 发布指引。OCI 的 Docker/Podman 发布需要管理员签发并授予仓库写入权限的服务账号凭据。仓库配置、访问授权及用户管理仍由管理员操作。

仓库列表在服务端逐项检查读取权限。待授权的 SSO 用户仍无法访问仓库。升级不需要数据库迁移，也不会改变现有用户角色、Keycloak 或 S3 配置。

## English

This release gives approved colleagues repository and artifact browsing in the Console. A `reader` can inspect readable repositories. A `writer` can also use Raw file upload, the Maven publish wizard, and OCI/npm/PyPI publish guides. OCI Docker/Podman publishing requires an administrator-issued service-account credential with a repository write grant. Repository configuration, access grants, and user management remain administrator operations.

Repository discovery checks read permission for each result on the server. Pending SSO users remain blocked. No database migration is required; existing roles, Keycloak settings, and S3 settings stay in place.
